column1: # HISTORICAL RT0-RT7 CROSSWALK - interpretation layer, NOT a production label.
# Production emits `state_id` in the GII.deriv.hmm coordinate system (LENG 471, sha256
# 292495a4...). The historical landmarks are POINTS in the prior frame RT17_CORE/B_span17
# (LENG 305, sha256 f3ddb0b5...), carried onto LtrA P0A3U0 residue numbering by g3.
# No measurement bridges production state -> prior frame. Every correspondence is therefore
# UNRESOLVED and stays UNRESOLVED until g7 lands one. See code/rtmap/crosswalk.py.
